Hi Lane and Giana,

This is Sara from Avicenna. Thank you once again for sharing your study materials with us. Based on this information, we have prepared a sample study for your team. This sample covers PHASE 1 - 3rd Trimester and is designed to last just 7 days, making it easy for you to test. Additionally, we’ve made some adjustments to help integrate it better into our system. If we proceed, we can customize our platform to implement the study exactly as you expect for the full project.

We’ve added a new section to your sample study called “How does it work?” that explains the schedules of your surveys. Also, we added a new survey called “Update My Schedule” that allows participants to customize their survey schedules based on their daily routine, which increases their compliance rate eventually.

To test your sample study from the participant's perspective, please follow the instructions below:
  1. Install the Avicenna mobile application on your smartphone. You can find the iOS app here and the Android app here.

  3. When you are asked to enter the study registration code, enter the provided Study ID and follow the instructions. Check this document to learn more about this registration process.
- Study ID: 4194
- Participants’ usernames:
  • participant1@uiowa.edu
  • participant2@uiowa.edu

Moreover, if you and your team would like to explore the researcher's side of our platform, you can create a researcher account here. Once done, please let us know so that we can add you as researchers to Study ID: 4194. As researchers, you will be able to access the sample study in your researcher dashboard.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
